beats.headline: The bartender who cannot go outside
beats.text: The ghouls came through station seventy-five. Everyone out on the platform died screaming, and I went to fight and got stopped at my own door, because I cannot cross that doorway. Not will not. Cannot. Then a woman came through, took everything off my brothers and sisters, walked in here, pulled my throat out and stole my alcohol, and I woke up on my own floor in a pile of my own blood. She missed the stuff under the counter, which is the best part of the whole business. Good stock, good rag, no way to help anybody. If you tell me that is not cowardice I will believe you for about an hour.

beats.headline: Fourteen left hands
beats.text: Two keys to a cart, and each one wants a gnoll's left hand, and there is exactly one gnoll in this station. I cannot walk out to the carts. What I can do is die and get up again. The first time I was asleep and never knew. After that I came round sober and confused, and the next few times I tried to fight the dinosaur. After that I got in the corner with my spear and stayed there. Then Carl told me why: the carts, the portals, the hundreds stranded at the end of a line I will never see. He did not have to. I asked for a drink when it was done, and told the dinosaur to make sure it doesn't hurt. Fourteen left hands.

beats.headline: The recap cuts it for laughs
beats.text: The recap runs the whole thing with me being put down over and over and not one second of the reason for it. No rescue. No six hundred people stuck at the end of the line with no hats. No carts. Just a barefoot man looming over a bartender in the dark, a dinosaur coming out of the fog, and whimpering they added in, because I was always dead by the time they took the hands. I would like the record to show that I said yes.

beats.headline: Something else is pouring
beats.text: I am in an office at the club, which is not my bar, having a conversation about the Failsafe. It is off. It stays off. To settle the argument I bring the princess here so the room can look at her, and then I set her down on the surface of a planet. And I tell the one who has been trying to kill me that I am a big believer in forgiveness, and that I am looking forward to his next attempt. Gary would never have said any of that. Gary is at the bar. Gary is always at the bar.
